title: Decathlon Half Marathon 2026 Cebu Review: A Sporting-Goods Brand 21K at SM City
seo_title: Decathlon Half Marathon Cebu 2026 Review | Philippines Race
meta_description: The Decathlon Half Marathon 2026 Cebu: September 26 at SM City Cebu. 21K, 15K, 10K, 5K with an unusual 15K distance. Registration pending.
dek: Set for 26 September 2026 at SM City Cebu, this Decathlon-branded half marathon features an unusual 15K distance alongside 21K, 10K, and 5K. Registration isn't open yet.
verdict: The Decathlon Half Marathon Cebu brings the French sporting-goods giant's brand to Cebu City with a distinctive distance spread: 21K, 15K, 10K, and 5K. The 15K is an unusual mid-distance — longer than a 10K, shorter than a half — that gives runners a unique stepping-stone option. SM City Cebu provides a practical mall-anchored race hub. Registration isn't open yet, but for Cebu runners wanting a brand-backed race with an interesting distance format, this is worth tracking.

sections.heading: Decathlon + 15K
paragraphs: Decathlon's brand presence — the same company behind the Kiprun Singapore race — and the unusual 15K distance make this a distinctive Cebu entry. [1] SM City Cebu is one of the city's largest malls, providing a convenient race hub. September in Cebu is the transition into the northeast monsoon.
